title: Robot grid
description: The Grid tab of Robot Framework suites and resources in the project view: one row per step, the keyword it calls and one cell per argument labelled with its parameter, resolved from the file's imports. Hover a keyword for its arguments and documentation; click a row to change it -- steps with keyword completion and one input per parameter, FOR / IF / WHILE / TRY blocks, settings, variables, tests and keywords, with ${variable} completion. Changes land in Script as unsaved edits.
